comment: Shared test vectors for normalizeGtin / gs1CheckDigit. Read by gtin.test.ts here and by ios/VendpireTests/GtinTests.swift as a bundle resource, so the TS and Swift implementations cannot drift apart the first time someone fixes a UPC-E edge case. Adding a case here is adding it to both suites.

normalize.note: UPC-E expands to UPC-A before the check digit is validated
separators and surrounding space are stripped
EAN-13, the zero-padded spelling a CSV tends to carry
native GTIN-14 with indicator digit 1 — a case, not a unit
already GTIN-14; indicator 0 is a unit, not a case
indicator 9 is reserved for variable measure, so not a case either
UPC-E with a wrong check digit
11 digits is not a GTIN length
UPC-E number system must be 0 or 1

equivalences.note: the same code spelled 12- and 13-digit must land on one GTIN-14
UPC-E and its expanded UPC-A are the same product
